description: A computerized behavioral task developed by Bialystok, Craik, and Ryan that measures response suppression, inhibitory control, and task switching through speeded responses to gaze and eye-color stimuli.
title: Faces task

description: A 32-competency, three-category assessment instrument developed by the VAST Community of Practice to evaluate healthcare simulation-facilitation performance and support faculty development, including in low-resource settings.
title: Facilitation Behavioural Assessment Tool

description: A character-education curriculum developed and delivered by Facing History & Ourselves that uses historical events, especially the Holocaust, to help middle and high school students examine identity, moral reasoning, and civic responsibility.
title: Facing History and Ourselves

description: A Minecraft-based game-based learning system developed by Yanjun Pan and colleagues that teaches middle-school computational thinking through factory-building gameplay, planning tools, and Canvas LMS integration.
title: Factory Craft

description: A web-based chatbot developed by Marques et al.
title: FACTRIA-aware chatbot

description: A flexible, evidence-informed framework proposed by Marques et al.
title: FACTRIA (Framework of Factors in the Analytical process and the data Context for Responsible Institutional Analytics)

description: A set of initiatives providing doctoral mentoring, networking, financial or preparatory support, and hiring-committee workshops to diversify the professoriate, run by the Southern Regional Education Board, Florida International University, and the University of California system respectively.
title: Faculty diversity pipeline programs (State Doctoral Scholars Program, STRIDE, California Pre-Doctoral Program)

description: Failure Free Reading is a scripted language-development and reading-intervention program for struggling Kindergarten–grade 12 readers, combining teacher instruction, talking software, workbook exercises, and independent reading activities.
title: Failure Free Reading

description: Fair Grader 2000 is NISSIN's standardized non-contact 3D scanning and scoring system for objectively evaluating dental cavity-preparation morphology, cutting volume, and volume ratio against a reference model.
title: Fair Grader 2000

description: A dataset of fall 2020 NWEA MAP Growth assessment scores from more than 535,000 K–8 students in 147 districts, assembled and analyzed by Megan Kuhfeld and colleagues to compare remotely and in-person administered tests.
title: Fall 2020 MAP Growth remote-versus-in-person comparability dataset

description: Family and Friends 2 MultiRom is Cambridge University Press's accompanying multimedia software providing game-like, computer-based grammar activities for learners using the Family and Friends 2 coursebook.
title: Family and Friends 2 MultiRom

description: The FCG-C is a four-domain framework of 19 entry-level family-caregiving competencies developed by a national consortium of nurse educators for prelicensure nursing programs.
title: Family Caregiving Competencies for Level One Nursing Education (FCG-C)

description: Family Check-Up is an ecological, school-based, family-centered intervention developed and delivered by trained providers using assessment, feedback, motivational interviewing, and tiered support to address family, behavioral, and academic needs.
title: Family Check-Up (FCU)

description: A job-embedded apprenticeship pathway run by the SEIU Educator Training Center with community-college and local partner sites to provide family child care providers with coursework, coaching, advising, and financial support toward California Child Development Permits.
title: Family Child Care Apprenticeship (FCC Apprenticeship)

description: A structured, family-led meeting approach in which families, children, professionals, and significant others develop a shared plan to address a child’s needs, including school participation and wellbeing.
title: Family Group Conference (FGC)

description: A family-led child-welfare decision-making programme used by social-service agencies to help families and professionals create safety and well-being plans for children and young people.
title: Family Group Conferencing (FGC)

description: A digital family science curriculum guide developed for the Early Science with Nico and Nor program, offering playful home and outdoor activities and conversation support for caregivers.
title: Family Science Fun Guide

description: Families and Schools Together (FAST), developed and implemented by Families and Schools Together, Inc., is a multifamily group programme that strengthens parenting, family relationships, and connections among families, schools, and communities.
title: FAST

description: Fast ForWord Language is a computer-based language and reading intervention program developed and marketed by Scientific Learning Corporation for learners needing support with English language proficiency and reading skills.
title: Fast ForWord®

description: Fast Track is a comprehensive, longitudinal intervention developed by the Conduct Problems Prevention Research Group to support children at risk for conduct problems through coordinated academic, behavioral, social, peer, and family services.
title: Fast Track

description: FASTalk is a text-message family-engagement programme that sends multilingual, at-home literacy activities to families to support learning partnerships between schools and historically underserved households.
title: FASTalk

description: FastPerson is a multimodal video-to-video summarization system developed by Kazuki Kawamura that generates condensed lecture videos while preserving the original speaker's voice and allowing chapter-level switching between summary and full versions.
title: FastPerson

description: Fathom is dynamic statistics software developed under the direction of Bill Finzer for educational exploration, visualization, and analysis of data.
title: Fathom

description: A cognitive-appraisal agent architecture for authoring synthetic agents with goals, emotions, beliefs, action tendencies, planning, and Theory-of-Mind models, used here in the MIXER intercultural-conflict learning environment.
title: FAtiMA (Fearnot AffecTIve Mind Architecture)
